answer: An AI-agent network mitigates Sybil attacks using optical interferometry across rugged terrain. Each agent must bounce a modulated laser off a retroreflector affixed to a cedar post across a windy canyon, resolving phase shifts caused by a passing zephyr. An attacker incurs verifiable physical costs installing discrete optical transceivers and acquiring land easements per identity. However, airborne dust and dense fog degrade optical coherence, causing false-positive verification failures.
